dishes.name: Spundekäs
dishes.desc: Soft spread of cream cheese, quark and paprika served with pretzels and raw onion. The classic bite in Mainz wine taverns.

dishes.name: Worscht and Weck
dishes.desc: Warm sausage (often Fleischwurst or Lyoner) with a crusty bread roll and mustard. The standard Rheinhessen wine-tavern snack.

dishes.name: Backesgrumbeere
dishes.desc: Potato casserole baked with bacon, onion and sour cream, with origins in Rheinhessen. Found in the wine taverns of Mainz and the villages around it.

dishes.name: Mainz potato stew
dishes.desc: Thick potato stew with bacon and Fleischwurst slices. Home-style winter food served in local Weinstuben.
